speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you have sudden-onset vertigo; to begin our assessment, have you experienced any hearing loss, ringing in your ears, or tinnitus alongside the spinning sensation?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old male. The patient presents to the emergency department with a sudden-onset sensation that the room is spinning, leading to several episodes of nausea and vomiting. The symptoms started as he was going to bed and lasted for approximately 3 minutes. He mentions that he has never experienced anything like this before and currently feels at his baseline.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Based on the patient's history of brief, spontaneous vertigo episodes without hearing loss or tinnitus, do you experience any weakness, numbness, double vision, or difficulty speaking during these spells?

REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain (posterior fossa)

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for confirming the MRI is normal, which rules out central causes like a stroke. Since your episodes last only about 3 minutes and are spontaneous, do you notice that the spinning sensation worsens specifically when you roll over in bed or tilt your head?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Sudden-onset sensation of the room spinning. I also have Nausea, Vomiting, Dizziness.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Based on your normal MRI and the brief, spontaneous nature of your episodes, I need to confirm if your vertigo is positional—does the spinning start immediately when you change head position, like rolling over or looking up?

Please also describe exactly how long each episode lasts and whether you see any involuntary eye movements (nystagmus) during these spells.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: The patient is otherwise healthy with only a history of eczema. No prior episodes of similar nature. Social history: No significant social history provided.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

The normal MRI rules out stroke, and your history of brief, spontaneous episodes lasting only 3 minutes without hearing loss is highly characteristic of BPPV. Have you noticed that the spinning sensation starts immediately when you roll over in bed or tilt your head?
